title: Show that width 2 does not survive an arc on the length-8 cycle
body:
## Summary
- On the length-8 width-2 cycle, every proper arc has Schur bandwidth equal to the diameter of the survivors that meet the arc. Deleting one vertex leaves bandwidth 4, with entry `-1/64` between the opposite survivors.
- Deleting `{2,3,4}` also leaves bandwidth 4, with entry `-5/216`. The inverse has norms `2257/1240`, inside the original bounds `2` and `10`.
- The selected κ is unchanged.
